purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Vihiga Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 300 DPI (3-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; the TOTAL row is the final green-shaded row on page 2, immediately after the 'VIHIGA PRISON - 01' special-facility polling station row). Both rows are unambiguous at this resolution.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-211-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 29,888 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (52,309) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (52,289). The 20-voter gap exactly matches VIHIGA PRISON - 01, a special-facility polling station printed on the same page immediately above the TOTAL row, which sits outside the ordinary Vihiga constituency ward series that the governed First Schedule denominator sums from. This is the same genuine printed-total-vs-ward-derived-denominator gap already documented for other constituencies' special-facility polling stations. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
